## About
The Diesel Shop, TDS Miami, is family-owned and operated by Enrique Gonzalez, a Puerto Rican-born Miami resident who has never been one to follow trends. He and his son Jesus run the shop on NW 88th Ave in Doral.
We specialize in Turbo Diesel High Performance for Duramax, Power Stroke and Cummins, and we handle the routine service too. Clients come from all over Florida and from as far as Texas, Georgia, New York and Canada.
Enrique's own shop truck, the D-max Colorado, is a Duramax swapped into a Colorado that can be driven daily, raced and shown. It has raced all over the United States. We're rated 4.9 from 140 Google reviews, and we'd be glad to meet you and your truck.

## Services
- Diagnostics: Accurate diagnostics on any Chevy, Ford or Dodge diesel truck.
- Preventative maintenance: Regular tune-ups keep your truck in good condition. Don't wait until it's too late.
- Tuning packages: Street or track, our tuning packages will put a grin on your face every time you drive your truck.
- High-performance build: Put our experience to work on your high-performance build.
- Suspension lift kits: Cutting edge suspension lift kits that clear bigger tires without compromising ride quality.
- Air suspension: Air suspension lets you choose a cushy ride on rough roads or a firmer ride for better handling.
- Train Horns: Want something more aggressive? We'll install a train horn.
- Brakes: One customer had us take care of the brakes on his truck and called the work super fast and reliable.

## FAQ
Q: What trucks do you work on?
A: We know Chevy Duramax, Ford Powerstroke and Dodge Cummins inside and out, and we work on big trucks for both service and mods.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday to Friday, 7 am to 5 pm. We're closed on weekends.

Q: Is there a veteran, police and firefighter discount?
A: One customer wrote that they received a 10% veteran, police and firefighter discount. Give us a call to ask about it.
